subject: Wilson early history-of-ideas genealogy
source: Daniel J Wilson Arthur O Lovejoy An Annotated Bibliography introduction scan JSON pp25-26
documented_finding: Wilson identifies Religion and the Time-Process and The Dialectic of Bruno and Spinoza as early history-of-ideas essays introducing the Platonic complex later embodied in the chain of being.
evidence_limit: Retrospective interpretation and not Lovejoy's own autobiographical statement.

subject: Buddhist article annotation
documented_finding: Wilson describes Lovejoy's 1898 Buddhist article as a technical effort to correct interpretations of upadana and upadisesa essential to Buddhist philosophy.
evidence_limit: Accurate summary does not exhaust the article's methodological significance.

subject: Cross-reference isolation
documented_finding: Entry19 carries no adjacent See-chain connecting it to Wilson's later Great Chain genealogy unlike entries21 and22.
evidence_limit: Absence of cross-reference does not prove conscious marginalization.

subject: Time-Process bridge
documented_finding: Wilson summarizes the 1902 article as spanning Western and Indian religious civilizations and cross-references Great Chain Bruno-Spinoza Obsolescence of the Eternal and Wilson's later interpretation.
evidence_limit: Cross-reference structure is editorial/historiographical evidence not causal evidence about Lovejoy.

subject: Bruno-Spinoza proto-Great-Chain
documented_finding: Wilson says the 1904 article anticipates The Great Chain of Being in structure examples and moral and emphasizes otherworldliness and plenitude.
evidence_limit: Secondary genealogy must be controlled against the primary 1904 text.

subject: Indic material inside 1904 metaphysical analysis
source: Lovejoy The Dialectic of Bruno and Spinoza pp144-148
documented_finding: The primary text uses Vedanta Mundaka Upanishad Schopenhauer as modern Vedantism Deussen and Maya within the article's central comparative analysis.
evidence_limit: Does not imply that Wilson was unaware of every Indic passage.

subject: Framework of western thought
source: Wilson entry435 summarizing Arthur O Lovejoy and the Moral of The Great Chain of Being JHI41 1980 scan JSON p189
documented_finding: Wilson says that by 1904 Lovejoy had outlined the framework of western thought later expanded in The Great Chain of Being and that its structure and moral remained stable.
evidence_limit: The phrase is Wilson's retrospective framing rather than Lovejoy's own description of the 1904 article.

subject: Historiographical partition synthesis
source: Wilson entries19 21 22 plus Lovejoy 1904 primary text
documented_finding: Wilson's architecture places 1898 Buddhism chiefly as technical philology while 1902 and 1904 feed the later history-of-ideas genealogy even though the 1904 primary text itself uses Indic material analytically.
evidence_limit: Interpretive synthesis; should be described as disciplinary partition rather than intentional exclusion.

subject: Adjacent publication ecology
documented_finding: Wilson documents 1904 publications on metaphysics international ethics current philosophy religious instruction and evolution in the same year.
evidence_limit: Chronological co-presence does not establish causal unity.
